title: Make print() use a single write() call
author: methane
body_preview: ### Feature or enhancement  Currently, `print("a", "b")` performs four separate writes:  ```python file.write("a") file.write(" ") file.write("b") file.write("\n") ```  The proposed behavior is equivalent to:  ```python file.write("a b\n") ```  The main motivation is to reduce interleaving between concurrent `print()` calls. title: Fix return type of __lazy_import__() (again)
author: JadenV15
body_preview: Sorry all, my earlier [pull](https://github.com/python/typeshed/pull/16742) was incorrect. Confusingly, `__lazy_import__()` is able to return a `ModuleType` OR a `LazyImportType`. See also [this issue](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/161715).
